prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Create one 1024×1024 opaque PNG app icon for Lull, a calm Montessori toybox app for toddlers. Full-bleed square artwork, not a mockup.
SCENE: a large cream matte modelling-clay CRESCENT MOON (#F6EFD9), tilted slightly within the flat composition, resting just above two soft rolling wool-felt hills. Near hill muted sage #8FA58A, far hill lighter sage #B9C9AE. Deep dusty-blue felt night sky #3D4A63 fills the square. Exactly FOUR small cream felt stars (#F6EFD9), in different sizes, with generous spacing. Moon approximately45% of total canvas width, dominant and clearly a crescent with a deep open curve, no face. Hill layers gently overlap along lower part of image; hilltops and entire moon inside central80% of canvas. Hills extend beyond bottom and side edges naturally. Nothing else.
STYLE: handmade miniature set photographed straight on. Soft wool felt with visible fine fibres for sky, hills and stars. Moon is MATTE MODELLING CLAY with faint irregular thumb marks, softly shaped by hand, not wool or paper. Restrained handworked imperfections, clean readable crescent silhouette. Soft diffuse upper-left light, small soft shadows BETWEEN physical layers. Flat front camera view, zero perspective tilt; only the crescent itself slightly tilted. Soft material depth without a shiny rendered look.
HARD RULES: square1024×1024, opaque, full bleed on all4edges. No rounded icon corners, borders, frames, surrounding page, outer drop shadow, vignette, lettering, words, logo, watermark, face, eyes, mouth, toys, cat, trees or added details. NOT cut paper, vector, glossy plastic, metallic or shiny3D rendering. Only four named base colors #F6EFD9 #8FA58A #B9C9AE #3D4A63, with natural felt/clay texture and soft contact shading. Read instantly at60pixels as a large moon over two hills. One image only.
status: Design candidate; not installed in app
